android.desc:
The Unbreakable Blocker for Deep Focus & a Better Life

Finally, a Blocker You Can't Cheat: Engineered from the ground up to be unbreakable. Once you commit, there are no loopholes or workarounds. ✔️ Pay Only When You Fail: The app is free to use when you succeed. We only get paid if you decide to break your own rules, creating powerful self-accountability. ✔️ Reclaim Your Productivity: Block digital noise to accomplish your most important work. ✔️ Strengthen Your Relationships: Create tech-free "Family Time" to be fully present with loved ones. ✔️ Protect Your Sleep: Automate a nightly wind-down routine by blocking stimulating apps and websites for better rest. ✔️ Powerful, Flexible Scheduling: Design your ideal day with custom schedules for work, family, and personal time. ✔️ Advanced Content Filtering: Instantly block pornography, social media, news, or any other distracting digital content. ✔️ 100% Ad-Free, Always: Your focus and privacy are our only product. We will never show you ads. To ensure the app is effective, disable all system optimizations and allow the app to run in the background. For details and guides, visit https://dontkillmyapp.com/. Xiaomi phones require special permissions to open whitelisted apps. Follow our guide here: https://team.urbandroid.org/ddc-fix-whitelisted-apps-on-xiaomi/. Automation To start detox automatically from Tasker or similar: - broadcast - package: com.urbandroid.ddc - action: com.urbandroid.ddc.START_DETOX - time_extra: number of millies Example: adb shell am broadcast --el time_extra 60000 -a com.urbandroid.ddc.START_DETOX Accessibility Service To effectively block you from using the addictive and distracting apps the "Digital Detox" app may ask you to enable its Accessibility Service if you decide to use the cheating protection features. We only use this service to block you from leaving an ongoing Detox without paying an accountability fee or using a quit code (the cheating). We do not use the service to collect any personal information. See how the use of Accessibility Service works in Digital Detox: https://youtu.be/XuJeqvyEAYw Device Admin If granted by the user, the "Digital Detox" app may use the Device Administrator permission to (and only to) prevent users from cheating - make uninstalling of the app during an active Detox harder.

quotes.text: If you're using Android the app Digital Detox is a good solution: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.urbandroid.ddc&hl=en&gl=US
